master.note: Leader line. 1.2.3 plus the one shared change that added GET_MOTOR_VERSION(0x58) to protocol_handler.c. The image briefly shipped as 1.2.6 because the two roles were forced onto one version number; that policy was dropped on 2026-09-24 and the leader was renumbered to its own line. Identical code — the 1.2.6 and 1.2.4 images differ in exactly two bytes, the patch byte. AFTER FLASHING, unplug the USB cable and the power cable at the same time, then reconnect both.

slave.note: Adds GET_MOTOR_VERSION(0x58): reads the MOTOR's own program version over the RobStride private-protocol version frame (manual p.31), because MIT Commands 12/13/14/15 go unanswered on this motor firmware and no motor parameter is readable in MIT. The command always ACKs OK -- check `valid`. IT MAY STOP THE MOTOR (the request reuses communication type 4), so it is not pollable. Measured: 0018s = 1.0.5.0.4, 0074s = 1.0.5.0.2 before its motor firmware was upgraded and 1.0.5.0.4 after -- the same unit before and after, which is how the upgrade was confirmed by reading rather than by assumption. Whether MIT can also answer the version read is NOT established. AFTER FLASHING, unplug the USB cable and the power cable at the same time, then reconnect both.
